summary: Maritaca AI's S5-free model is free for a limited time with no token charges. It accepts text only and excludes the Batch API, Flex and built-in tools. Limits are fixed across all tiers at 60 requests per minute and 256k input plus 256k output tokens per minute. Maritaca describes it as a temporary launch offer that may end at any time and recommends S5 for production use.
